author: Linnaeus, 1758
summary: 작은 무리를 지어 우리나라에 찾아오는 겨울새로, 물가 풀밭과 갈대밭, 습한 초원에서 지낸다. 주로 식물성 먹이를 먹지만 곤충도 잘 먹는다. 번식지에서는 풀밭 땅 위에 밥그릇 모양 둥지를 틀고 한 해에 두 번 번식하며, 한배에 알 4~5개를 낳는다. 캄차카, 사할린, 아무르, 우수리, 홋카이도 등지에서 번식하고 한국, 일본, 만주 남부, 중국 남부에서 겨울을 난다.

sexes.female: 수컷보다 색이 옅고, 갈색 머리에 흰 눈썹선과 뺨선이 있다.

young: 어린새는 암컷과 비슷하나 윗면 줄무늬가 더 굵고 아랫면이 누런 담황색이며, 가슴과 옆구리에 검은 세로줄과 점이 많다. 첫겨울 수컷은 머리와 멱의 검은색이 담황색 깃 끝에 가려 암컷처럼 보인다.

similar.how: 북방검은머리쑥새는 더 작고 부리가 가늘며 작은날개덮깃이 잿빛이지만, 검은머리쑥새는 작은날개덮깃이 적갈색이고 옆구리에 줄무늬가 더 많다.

art.subject: Common Reed Bunting (Emberiza schoeniclus), adult male in winter, as seen in Korean reed beds from November to March: the black head largely veiled by brown and buff feather tips, so the crown and ear coverts look mottled brown and black, with a pale buff supercilium; white submoustachial stripe running back into a partly hidden whitish collar; chin and throat buff with black showing through as a mottled bib; mantle and scapulars rufous-brown boldly streaked black with buff edges; lesser coverts rufous-chestnut; rump greyish-brown; underparts whitish with fine brown streaks on the breast sides and flanks; tail blackish with white outer feathers. Bill small and conical, brown; iris brown; legs brown.
art.pose: perched on a reed stem, side view
art.scene: Korean winter: reed bed and damp grassy meadow at the water's edge; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male winter, side view perched on a reed stem: brown-veiled black head with buff supercilium, white submoustachial stripe, mottled black bib, rufous-brown back streaked black, rufous lesser coverts, whitish underparts, brown bill and legs
adult male breeding (from late March), side view perched: solid black head and throat, bold white submoustachial stripe joining a white nape collar, black-streaked rufous-brown back, white underparts

adult female winter, side view perched: brown crown and ear coverts, buffish-white supercilium, white submoustachial stripe edged by a black malar line, whitish throat, finely streaked breast sides, streaked rufous-brown back
art.build: Medium-sized bunting, 16cm, a little larger and longer-tailed than a sparrow. Rounded head without a crest. Bill small and conical with a slightly convex culmen, shorter than the head. Legs short, brown. Clings to and perches on reed stems, often flicking and half-spreading the tail. At rest the wingtips reach only the base of the tail. Tail rather long, slightly notched, blackish with white outer feathers that flash in flight.
avoid: Do not paint a solid black head on the winter scene bird; in the Korean winter months the black is veiled by brown fringes.
Do not paint blue-grey lesser coverts or very pale sandy plumage; those mark Pallas's Reed Bunting.
Do not place the white on the cheeks; it is a stripe below the cheek (submoustachial) that joins the collar.
Do not add any yellow, and do not give it a crest.
